claims.claim: urllib3's ProxyManager class accepts the proxy_ssl_context parameter for configuring HTTPS proxy TLS settings.
urllib3's HTTPResponse.stream() method returns an iterator that yields response payload chunks.
urllib3 relies on Python's standard zlib module to decode Deflate-compressed response streams.
urllib3's HTTPResponse.stream() always buffers chunk-size lines of unbounded length in memory.
claims.citation: `HTTPResponse.stream()` and `read_chunked()` could buffer a chunk-size line of unbounded length in memory.

claims.claim: Destination client certificates no longer apply to HTTPS connections in urllib3.
claims.citation: Destination client certificates and identity overrides no longer apply to HTTPS forwarding proxy connections.

claims.claim: urllib3 requires configuring both proxy_assert_hostname and proxy_assert_fingerprint for proxy identity checks.
